name: agentos-mods
description: Claude Code mods recommended by AgentOS, pinned to reviewed commits. Anthropic-authored first; third-party entries are labelled and pinned, never vendored.

plugins.name: token-weather
plugins.description: Context-window forecast above the prompt: fill %, tokens, sparkline of recent turns. Read-only.

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: /replay steps through the file edits Claude made in the last turn, one diff at a time. Never blocks.

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Holds risky shell commands (rm -rf, reset --hard, force push…) and shows what they would change. INTERACTIVE ONLY: disable it for headless claude -p runs (see mods/README.md).

plugins.name: savvy-progress
plugins.description: THIRD-PARTY (JohnnyVizz, MIT). Live panel of subagents with model, progress and estimated usage; /agents-info.

plugins.name: skins
plugins.description: THIRD-PARTY (hellosverre, MIT). Seven live themes for what Claude Code draws; /skin <name>. Does a small update-check fetch to raw.githubusercontent.com.
